messages:
elaine: quick heads-up  saw recurring late-token fuzz on mixed-precision longctx runs. not the usual perf blip looks like cache churn + slot-compaction noise. short thread to align on a low-risk path forward.
omar: any concrete numbers?
elaine: deg-regression up ~9% on a 2k token eval subset when FP8/INT8/4bit slices co-reside in same cache page. reproducer attached to PR.
yu: hypothesis: compaction routine packs entries tightly and occasionally truncates or moves entries assuming fixed entry-size; mixed quant increases variance in entry footprint so eviction heuristics misfire.
ben: simple mitigations: (A) adaptive per-entry TTL based on quant_id & observed eviction_pressure, (B) compact-on-threshold only for homogeneous-bit pages, (C) tiny entry header for safe deserialization (5 bytes: magic/ver/quant/len-hi/len-lo).
elaine: I like A+header as lowest risk. A: if page sees >x cross-bit writes in T window, increase TTL for entries from the longctx bucket for M minutes to reduce churn.
omar: tradeoff: longer TTL increases mem usage. we should bound increase by per-model mem budgets. propose formula: new_ttl = min(ttl_max, base_ttl * (1 + alpha * cross_bit_rate)). make alpha tunable per-tenant.
yu: also record cheap histogram telemetry: page_cross_bit_rate, page_compactions, avg_entry_len_by_quant. this helps correlate mem delta to deg delta. add fields: "quant_header_present":bool, "page_cross_bit_rate":float, "entry_ttl_override":int, "compaction_cause".
ben: For (B) we can mark pages as "homogeneous" if last N writes match same quant_id; compaction allowed only on homogeneous pages. falling back to soft-compact that pads entries to max-quant-size to avoid moving entries across formats.
elaine: padding is clever but increases per-entry blowup; should be optional for large pages only. metrics to monitor: tokens/sec, tail_p99, deg_delta, mem_pressure.
omar: ops-bot can we schedule a canary? plan: header-only shadow 10% -> header+adaptive-ttl 5% canary -> header+homogeneous-compaction 2% if needed.
ops-bot: Canary pipeline created: shadow-header-10pct starting 6305551300, canary-report to #eng-ml-canaries.
yu: replay plan: capture compact tuple (model, prompt_fingerprint, seed, initial_page_digest, bits_seq, compaction_flag). include sampling of real page state to reconstruct. recommend 0.5% shadow replays before canary.
ben: microbench: simulate worst-case mix ratio and measure mem blowup under ttl multipliers [1x,1.5x,2x] and page occupancy. I'll attach graphs in PR.
elaine: ok action items: ben -> implement header + page-homogeneity tag + microbench, yu -> telemetry proto + replay tuple, omar -> pricing-aware ttl cap per-tenant, ops -> run shadow/canary. I'll open tracking issue and link PRs. thanks :thumbsup:
